# Proto-Gospel of James Chapter 16 — The EMET Bible (Literal)

**Translator:** EMET | **Source:** P.Bodmer V / Greek MSS, Proto-Gospel of James 16 | **Source Image:** source-texts/greek-EC/POX_016_page_001.jpg

---

## Chapter 16

**16:1** And the priest said, "Give back the virgin whom you received from the temple of the Lord." And Joseph burst into tears. And the priest said, "I will give you to drink the water of the conviction of the Lord, and it will make your sin manifest before your eyes."

**16:2** And the priest took the water and made Joseph drink and sent him into the wilderness, and he came back whole. And he made Mary drink and sent her into the wilderness, and she came back whole. And all the people marveled because sin was not revealed in them.

**16:3** And the priest said, "If the Lord God has not made your sin manifest, neither do I condemn you." And he let them go. And Joseph took Mary and departed to his house, rejoicing and glorifying the God of Israel.
